nodes.name: HubSpot Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives HubSpot Workflow 'Send a webhook' calls or Webhooks API event arrays for companies and contacts. Pinned fictional fixtures are attached for SANDBOX_MODE testing.

nodes.name: Parse & Authenticate Events
nodes.notes: Shared-secret (default) or HubSpot v3 signature check. Splits payloads into one item per object.

nodes.name: Fetch HubSpot Record
nodes.notes: GET the fresh CRM record. Never Error is on so 404/429 reach the merge node as data.

nodes.name: Gatekeeper: Normalise, Filter & ICP
nodes.notes: Root-domain normalisation, free/disposable filtering, ICP fit, record-level cooldown.

nodes.name: HubSpot Domain Cooldown Lookup
nodes.notes: CRM search: any company on this root domain enriched or dispatched inside the cooldown window?

nodes.name: Credit Guard: Ledger & Daily Budget
nodes.notes: Rolling dedupe ledger + daily credit cap in workflow static data. Reserves credits before dispatch.

nodes.name: Dispatch to Clay Table
nodes.notes: Live only (DRY_RUN=false and SANDBOX_MODE=false). URL and auth come from env and are never written to item data.

nodes.name: Update HubSpot Enrichment Status
nodes.notes: PATCH clay_enrichment_status / skip reason / root domain / timestamps.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: One redacted JSON audit record per object. stdout + static-data ring buffer.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow (Workflow settings).

parameters.content:
## n8n-clay-webhook-enrichment-credit-guard
Pre-enrichment gatekeeper between HubSpot and Clay. dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. Nothing leaves n8n until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute with pinned fixtures (13 fictional calls).
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`, `DRY_RUN=true`: real HubSpot reads, no writes, no Clay calls.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false` with a low `DAILY_CREDIT_BUDGET`.

Set this workflow as its own Error Workflow in Settings. See README.md.

### Credit guard
Ledger + budget live in workflow static data, which n8n saves only for **production** (active) executions. Run one execution at a time (queue concurrency 1) or move the ledger to Redis/Postgres for parallel workers.

### Sanitized error path
Stack traces, headers and request options are dropped. Tokens, Clay URLs and emails are redacted.
